questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Camp Australia and/or Jabiru (the Parties).
How closely do the Parties compete in the supply of OSHC and vacation care services in Queensland and south-east Queensland?

Identify the key factors on which OSHC and vacation care service providers compete when participating in tenders for schools (e.g. price, service quality, staffing, programming, technology, reputation, safety).
Please identify the factors that are most important when selecting a provider. Does the importance of these factors differ depending on whether the school is a state, independent or religious school?

Identify the main competitors to the Parties in the supply of OSHC and vacation care services in Queensland and south-east Queensland for (i) all school types (state, independent, religious) and (ii) state schools only. For each, identify the strongest and weakest competitors, having regard to the factors in question 3.

Describe whether smaller OSHC and vacation care service providers, including providers which operate only 1 or 2 sites, are able to compete in tenders for school contracts, or if they face any barriers or disadvantages.
Are OSHC and vacation care service providers that do not have a presence in Queensland able to compete for tenders in Queensland? To what extent do these providers compete?
How easily can schools in Queensland switch to alternative OSHC and vacation care service providers? Are there any contractual limitations on doing so?
Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition.
